cycle12 critique 계획대로 recApply()/recSave()의 부분 수정 경로(scope='one'/'future')에 twGuard+undo를 통일했다. 두 함수 맨 앞에 if(twGuard())return;을 추가해 튜토리얼 중 실제 DB 반영을 막았고, recApply의 scope='one' 삭제(r.skip.push)는 push 전 배열 스냅샷을, scope='future' 삭제(r.endDate 절단)는 이전 endDate 스냅샷을 떠서 각각 undoToast로 되돌릴 수 있게 했다(scope='all'은 기존처럼 deleteRecsUndo로 위임, 변경 없음). recSave()의 세 분기도 동일하게: scope='one'은 edits[date] 덮어쓰기 전 이전 값(없었으면 undefined)을 스냅샷해 undo 시 원래 상태로 복원(이전에 없었으면 키 자체를 delete), scope='future'는 endDate 스냅샷 + 새로 push한 분리 레코드를 undo 시 filter로 제거, scope='all'은 r.amount 스냅샷 후 복원. 두 함수 모두 plain toast 대신 undoToast()로 교체했다. test/run.js에 recApply/recSave를 추출 대상에 추가하고(uid/closeSheet/renderTxSheet 스텁, $('txAmt') 값을 반환하는 $ 스텁, window 전역 신설) 9개 회귀 테스트 추가(scope별 적용+undo 3쌍, edits 덮어쓰기 case, 튜토리얼 차단 2건) -- 69/69 통과. 디버깅 중 vm.createContext 샌드박스에서 만들어진 객체/배열은 메인 realm과 프로토타입이 달라 assert.deepStrictEqual이 실패한다는 걸 발견해, 그런 값은 개별 프로퍼티(assert.strictEqual)나 길이 비교로 검증하도록 테스트를 수정했다(기존 배열 비교 테스트들은 애초에 메인 realm에서 만든 배열을 push/filter만 했기 때문에 문제없이 통과했던 것). 두 인라인 <script> 블록 모두 node --check로 파싱 확인. Stepped back from the bug-fixing pattern of the last several cycles to look for a genuine product gap rather than another small bug. Found one: DB.budgets is initialized as an empty object in migrate() but that single line is its ONLY reference anywhere in the codebase (verified via grep) — nothing ever reads or writes it, and the .budget-card CSS class is likewise defined but never used in any template. Meanwhile spendByCategory()/openSpendAnalysis() (the existing '지출 분석' sheet) already compute and display per-category spending for the month with a progress-bar UI, just relative to total spend rather than any budget limit. This is a half-built core feature of a budget-tracking app — the data model was scaffolded but the actual budget-setting UX was never connected. No code changed this phase (as intended for critique) — wrote a concrete plan to pending_advance_plan: extend the existing openSpendAnalysis() sheet (rather than building a new screen) to let the user tap a category row to set a monthly budget limit stored in DB.budgets[category], switch that row's progress bar to show usage-vs-budget (clamped, highlighted red when over 100%) while categories without a set budget keep today's behavior unchanged, and add regression tests for the percentage math including the divide-by-zero edge case.

Implemented cycle 5's critique plan: connected the previously-dead DB.budgets scaffolding to a real feature by extending the existing openSpendAnalysis() ('지출 분석') sheet instead of building a new screen. Tapping a category row now opens openBudgetPrompt(idx), which reads/writes DB.budgets[category] via saveBudget()/delBudget(). Extracted the percentage math into a pure budgetProgress(spent,budget) helper: when a budget is set, the row's progress bar switches from 'share of total spend' to 'usage vs budget' (clamped to 100% width so the bar never overflows), turns from --brand to --expense once spending exceeds the budget, and the amount/percentage text also gets the --expense highlight; categories with no budget keep today's total-share behavior unchanged. doRenameCat() now migrates DB.budgets[old]->DB.budgets[new] on expense-category rename, mirroring the existing catIcon/catVar migration pattern (delCat leaves orphaned budget entries alone, same as it already does for catIcon/catVar). Bumped APP_VERSION 1.17.3->1.17.4 and sw.js CACHE v38->v39.

delCat(k,i) only spliced the category out of DB.categories[k] but never cleaned up DB.catIcon[catKey(k,c)], DB.catVar[catKey(k,c)], or (for expense) DB.budgets[c] — the exact same class of orphaned-parallel-map bug that doRenameCat already had to fix for rename, but delete was never given the same treatment. Since catKey is purely name-based, deleting a category (e.g. '커피' with a custom icon, a '변동' flag, and a 30,000원 budget) and later re-adding one with the same name silently inherited the old icon/variable-flag/budget the user never set. Extracted the deletion body into doDeleteCat(k,i), mirroring doRenameCat's migration pattern, which now also deletes the catIcon/catVar entries and (for k==='expense') the budgets entry for the deleted category name; delCat() just calls it inside the existing confirmSheet callback. Added 3 new regression tests to test/run.js (icon/var/budget cleanup on delete, no inheritance on same-name re-add, and a guard that non-expense types don't touch DB.budgets) — all 27 tests pass. Verified both inline <script> blocks still parse via `new Function()`. Bumped APP_VERSION 1.17.4→1.17.5 and sw.js CACHE v39→v40.

addCat(k) was the odd one out among the app's 'add/rename named item' flows: addOwner() and doRenameCat() both check for a duplicate name and toast('이미 있는 카테고리예요'/'이미 있는 귀속이에요') before returning, but addCat() just silently skipped the DB.categories[k].push() on a duplicate and still cleared the draft, saved, and reopened the sheet — giving the user zero feedback that nothing happened when they typed an existing category name. Worse, if the user had picked a custom icon in catAddDraft.icon first, the DB.catIcon[catKey(k,v)]=catAddDraft.icon line still ran unconditionally, silently overwriting the icon of the pre-existing category with the same name. Fixed by adding the same early-return-with-toast guard used by addOwner/doRenameCat, which also fixes the icon-overwrite side effect since the function now returns before touching catIcon. Added addCat to the test harness's FUNCTIONS list and gave the sandbox toast() a lastToast recorder (previously a no-op) plus a catAddDraft field so it could be exercised; added 2 new regression tests (duplicate name toasts and leaves array/icon untouched; new name adds normally with no toast) — all 37 tests pass. Verified both inline <script> blocks still parse via new Function(). Bumped APP_VERSION 1.18.0→1.18.1 and sw.js CACHE v41→v42.

cycle11 critique 계획대로 index.html의 독립 토글 스위치 4곳(2457: 자산 총자산에 포함, 2881: 조정 내역 수지에 포함, 2973: 반복 이체 자동 확인, 3717: 시세 자동 갱신)을 <span class="switch" onclick=...>에서 <button type="button" role="switch" aria-checked aria-label>로 바꿔 키보드/스크린리더로 조작 가능하게 했다. 각 인라인 onclick에 this.setAttribute('aria-checked',...) 한 줄씩 추가해 클릭 시 상태가 같이 갱신되게 했고, .switch CSS에 button 기본 스타일 리셋(appearance/border/padding/cursor)과 :focus-visible 아웃라인을 추가했다. 이미 부모가 button인 menu-item 안의 나머지 switch(3430줄)는 중첩 인터랙티브 요소가 되지 않도록 span은 aria-hidden=true로 두고, 부모 button에 aria-pressed를 추가해 토글 상태를 노출했다. 순수 마크업/속성 변경이라 새 회귀 테스트는 추가하지 않고 기존 58/58 스위트 통과와 두 인라인 <script> 블록의 new Function() 파싱을 확인했다.
